andrew: Heads-up: launching night window at 2026-11-05 00:30 UTC. Need confirmations on smoke owners, rollback, and who watches metrics.

sarah: I merged the hotfix to main at 00:02 UTC. CI passed. PR #4821 - no config drift.

mike: I can own rollback. Plan: revert canary flag + redeploy previous image tag `rci-2026-10-30`. I'll be on standby 00:25-01:00 UTC. @andrew ping me to trigger.

lena: I'll watch SLO dashboard and error-rate alerts. Pager is on. Add me to manual alert pings if needed.

tara: I'll run the smoke checklist at T+5. Smoke commands are below:
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/healthz | jq .status
kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/infer-runtime --timeout=3m\```

sarah: Quick QA: confirm `enable_new_routing=true` is only on canary lanes.

andrew: confirmed — canary lanes only. Prod lanes stay `enable_new_routing=false`.

devops-bot: Scheduled deploy job #deploy-2834567890 queued for 2026-11-05T00:30:00Z. Will post start/finish events.

mike: :thumbsup: Rollback command (handy):
```
helm rollback inference-chart 1 -n inference\```

tara: I'll post smoke results in-thread. Abort criteria: any 5xx on generation or p50 > 300ms.

andrew: Approvals needed: @sarah (merge), @mike (rollback), @lena (monitor) — please reply `ack` when ready.

sarah: ack

mike: ack

lena: ack

andrew: Great. Trigger window at 00:30. If no `abort` message by 00:29, proceed. Final checklist here:
- code merged: yes
- canary flag set: yes
- canary capacity: 1% traffic
- smoke owner: tara
- rollback owner: mike
- metrics watcher: lena

andrew: Ops runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/night-deploy (linked, please review).

tara: starting smoke in ~10m. I'll timestamp each step.

devops-bot: Deploy started by deployer=andrew at 2026-11-05T00:30:02Z

tara: smoke 1/4 health check: OK (200, status "ok")

tara: smoke 2/4 inference ping: 120ms p50, sample generation returned expected tokens

tara: smoke 3/4 auth token check: 200 OK

tara: smoke 4/4 end-to-end sample generation: PASS

andrew: :rocket: canary looks healthy. Increasing to 10% per rollout plan.

lena: Observability: error rate <0.1% and p95 latency stable. No alert triggers.

mike: Holding on rollback; not required.

devops-bot: Deploy finished SUCCESS at 2026-11-05T00:42:10Z

andrew: Closing thread — thanks everyone. I'll add the rollout notes to the release doc and update the post-deploy checklist.
